symptoms.question: Have you been feeling feverish or measured a raised temperature?
Do you currently have a cough?
Does your throat feel sore or painful?
Do you have a runny or blocked nose?
Have you been sneezing frequently?
Do you currently have a headache?
Do you feel unusually tired or weak?
Do you have muscle or body aches?
Do you have difficulty breathing or feel unusually breathless?
Do you have chest pain or chest discomfort?
Do you feel nauseated or likely to vomit?
Have you been vomiting?
Are you passing loose or watery stools?
Do you have pain or cramping in your abdomen?
Does it hurt or burn when you urinate?
Do you need to urinate more often than usual?
Is it painful or difficult to bend your neck forward?
Are you unusually confused or hard to wake?
Have you seen blood in stool or vomit?
Are you having sweating episodes at night?

diseases.name: Malaria
diseases.description: A mosquito-borne infection that can cause fever and other systemic symptoms.
risk_factors: Recent travel to an area where malaria occurs
diseases.advice: Seek prompt clinician or travel-health assessment, especially after travel or in a malaria-risk area.

diseases.name: Typhoid fever
diseases.description: An infection that can cause prolonged fever and gastrointestinal symptoms.
risk_factors: Recent travel to an area with typhoid transmission
diseases.advice: Arrange a clinician assessment if fever persists or follows relevant travel or exposure.

diseases.name: Influenza
diseases.description: A respiratory viral infection that may cause fever, cough, and body aches.
risk_factors: Close contact with someone who is sick
diseases.advice: Consider clinician advice if symptoms are severe, worsening, or lasting unusually long.

diseases.name: Common cold
diseases.description: A usually mild viral infection involving the upper airways.
risk_factors: Recent close contact with respiratory illness
diseases.advice: Rest and consider routine clinician advice if symptoms worsen or do not improve.

diseases.name: Pneumonia
diseases.description: An infection of the lungs that can cause cough and breathing difficulty.
diseases.advice: Seek prompt medical assessment for breathing difficulty or possible pneumonia.

diseases.name: Urinary tract infection
diseases.description: A urinary infection that commonly causes local urinary symptoms.
diseases.advice: Arrange clinician assessment for urinary symptoms, fever, flank pain, or worsening illness.

diseases.name: Gastroenteritis
diseases.description: An intestinal infection or irritation that can cause vomiting and diarrhea.
risk_factors: Recent shared food or close contact
diseases.advice: Seek care for dehydration, blood, severe pain, or symptoms that worsen or persist.

diseases.name: Hypertension
diseases.description: Persistently raised blood pressure that often has no immediate symptoms.
diseases.advice: Use repeated, properly measured blood pressure readings and arrange clinician follow-up.

diseases.name: COVID-19
diseases.description: A respiratory viral infection with a range of possible symptoms.
risk_factors: Recent exposure to a person with COVID-19
diseases.advice: Follow current local guidance and seek care if breathing difficulty or other concerning symptoms occur.

diseases.name: Tuberculosis
diseases.description: A bacterial infection that most often affects the lungs and can cause a prolonged cough.
risk_factors: Recent residence or travel in a high-burden area
diseases.advice: Arrange clinician assessment for a cough lasting several weeks or persistent night sweats.

red_flags.description: Chest pain with shortness of breath
